name: The Content Creator Hub
tagline: Your complete content creation command center
description: An all-in-one content creation workspace for YouTubers, TikTokers, bloggers, and Instagram creators. Streamline your entire workflow from idea to published post, track performance, and maintain brand consistency across every platform.
benefits: Save 10+ hours weekly by centralizing your entire content workflow in one place
Never miss a posting deadline with visual calendar scheduling and status tracking
Repurpose content 5x faster with organized idea and script databases
Track what's working and double down on winning content formats with built-in analytics
Maintain brand consistency across all platforms with centralized asset storage
whats_included: 5 interconnected databases with pre-built relations and rollups
4 bonus templates for quick content starts
Platform-specific content templates for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Blog
Analytics tracking framework with KPI calculations
Brand guidelines template with visual asset storage
perfect_for: YouTubers managing multiple video series and upload schedules
TikTok creators posting daily short-form content
Bloggers maintaining editorial calendars with multiple content types
Instagram influencers coordinating reels, stories, carousels, and posts
features: Cross-platform content calendar with drag-and-drop scheduling
Idea capture system with virality potential scoring
Script writing templates with word count and timing targets
Analytics dashboard with engagement rate and growth calculations
Brand asset library with color swatches and font previews
Complete content pipeline from idea to published status
Repurposing tracker to maximize content ROI across platforms
Collaboration-ready fields with assignee, due dates, and priority
linked_databases: Content Ideas → Content Calendar (link ideas to scheduled posts)
Content Calendar → Scripts & Captions (connect scheduled posts to scripts)
Content Calendar → Analytics (link published content to performance data)
Brand Assets → Content Calendar (attach brand elements to scheduled content)
Scripts & Captions → Analytics (track which script styles perform best)
dashboard_widgets: Upcoming Content This Week (calendar view widget)
Top Performing Posts (analytics summary with engagement rates)
Ideas Waiting to Develop (backlog counter with priority tags)
Platform Distribution (visual breakdown of content by platform)
Monthly Publishing Goals (progress bars with completion percentages)
bonus_templates: TikTok Hook Formula Library (proven opening scripts)

databases.name: Content Ideas
databases.description: Capture, score, and develop content ideas before they enter your production pipeline
views: All Ideas (gallery view with cover images)
Viral Potential (table sorted by score)
By Platform (board view grouped by YouTube/TikTok/Instagram/Blog)
Idea Backlog (list view filtered to unstarted ideas)

databases.name: Content Calendar
databases.description: Schedule and track content across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and your blog with full status workflow
views: Monthly Calendar (calendar view with date scheduling)
By Status (board view: Idea → Scripting → Filming → Editing → Scheduled → Published)
Upcoming 7 Days (timeline view of near-term content)
All Platforms (table view with filters and sorting)

databases.name: Scripts & Captions
databases.description: Write, store, and version your scripts and captions with platform-specific formatting and word counts
views: All Scripts (table view with word count and status)
By Content Type (board view: Video Script/Reel Caption/Blog Post/Story Series)
Draft Scripts (gallery view of works in progress)
Final Versions (list view filtered to approved scripts)

databases.name: Analytics
databases.description: Track performance metrics across platforms to identify what content resonates with your audience
views: Performance Dashboard (table with views, likes, comments, shares, saves)
Top Performers (table sorted by engagement rate descending)
By Platform (board view grouped by platform with averages)
Monthly Trends (timeline view showing performance over time)

databases.name: Brand Assets
databases.description: Centralize your brand colors, fonts, logos, templates, and visual guidelines for consistent branding across all content
views: All Assets (gallery view with visual previews)
By Category (board view: Colors/Fonts/Logos/Templates/Graphics)
Color Palette (gallery view filtered to hex codes and swatches)
Templates (table view of reusable content templates)
